title: Ex 1.1 #32 · |{{{1, 4}, a, b, {{3, 4}}, {∅}}}|
prompt: Find the cardinality $|\{\{\{1, 4\}, a, b, \{\{3, 4\}\}, \{\emptyset\}\}\}|$: how many elements does the set have?
answer_format: A whole number: how many elements the set has.
hints: Count only the things separated by commas at the outermost level of braces.
An element that is itself a set (even ∅) counts as one element, however much is inside it.
solution: The outer braces hold just one element: the set {{1, 4}, a, b, {{3, 4}}, {∅}}.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
